VghLantern__PdfWriter__Config.VghLantern__PdfWriter__Config__Descripti: Settings for the single PDF writer every export route in the application goes through. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by AppCore ConfigLoader and read back through ConfigLoader.GetSection('PdfWriter'). The writer owns page assembly, page size per page, and the footer; what is painted onto a page belongs to that page's painter, not here.

VghLantern__PdfWriter__Config__Document.UnitNote: Every painter in the application works in paper millimetres. Changing this would silently rescale every drawn coordinate in the app.
VghLantern__PdfWriter__Config__Document.FallbackFilenameNote: Used only when a filename pattern resolves to separators and digits-free rubbish. An honest generic name beats a name that looks like a bug.

VghLantern__PdfWriter__Config__Footer.SkipOnPageKindsNote: A drawing sheet carries its own titleblock, which is the sheet's identification. A running footer printed over or beside the drawing border reads as a defect on an issued drawing. Numbering still counts every physical page, so the numbers printed on the document pages stay truthful.
VghLantern__PdfWriter__Config__Footer.FooterNote: The on-screen Preview and Send pages read this same block, so the footer a user sees is the footer the file gets.

VghLantern__PdfWriter__Config__Messages.LibraryUnavailable: PDF export failed - the jsPDF library did not load.
VghLantern__PdfWriter__Config__Messages.WriteFailed: PDF export failed - see the browser console for details.
